blockers.lossless_separation: NO: baked eye pixels hide underlying facial fur. Standing eyes are donors only; clean seated face missing.
NO for complete motion: exposed pixels could be isolated but hidden shoulders/torso are absent from body PNG.

needed: grip contact and front/back hand occlusion
blockers.lossless_separation: NO for complete independent tablet: hands/torso occlude portions; pixels are not recoverable by crop.
NO: flattened face has closed smiling eyes baked in. Home/cloud eye coordinates do not transfer to reclining pose.
NO: hidden contact pixels missing. Café coffee; pajamas pillow; astronaut v2 NO DRINK; never add universal juice.
NO for complete motion: rope/cloth/Pio flattened together; two fixed endpoints cannot remain fixed under one rigid rotation.
